sources.title: ViT Variants | OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The ViT variants in VideoMAEv2 provide a spectrum of options to balance performance requirements and computational resources. The ViT-giant model achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple video understanding benchmarks, while the distilled ViT-small and ViT-base models offer more efficient alternatives with strong performance.
